clusters.headline: Delhi Air Quality Reaches Severe Levels Following Deepavali Festival
aiSummaryBullets: Air quality in Delhi approached severe levels with an AQI of 383 recorded on the morning after Deepavali.
The Supreme Court of India identified vehicle emissions as a primary contributor to the regional air pollution crisis.

clusters.headline: Gurugram Teen Develops Solar-Powered Three-Wheeler For Families
aiSummaryBullets: A Gurugram-based teenager constructed a three-wheeled solar vehicle.
The project was completed with a budget of approximately Rs 102,536.

clusters.headline: Hasanamba Temple Sees Large Crowds As Political Rhetoric Intensifies
aiSummaryBullets: Large numbers of pilgrims are currently visiting the Hasanamba Temple.
The Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh requested an apology from political rivals before a planned visit to the Ram Temple.

clusters.headline: Sonia Gandhi Reflects On Life And Politics In New Memoir Belonging
aiSummaryBullets: Sonia Gandhi is set to release her memoir titled Belonging: A Journey of Love, detailing her transition from a private life to public politics.
The book covers her personal experiences with loss, her decision to decline the Prime Minister position, and her reflections on the Emergency period.

clusters.headline: IndiGo Flight From Bengaluru To Lucknow Returns Over Hijack Threat
aiSummaryBullets: An IndiGo aircraft en route to Lucknow returned to Kempegowda International Airport shortly after takeoff.
The decision followed the discovery of a note in an aircraft restroom warning of a planned hijacking at 6:30.

clusters.headline: Recent Gun Violence Incidents Reported In Vijayapura And Delhi Area
aiSummaryBullets: Police in Vijayapura wounded a murder suspect who allegedly opened fire while attempting to evade arrest.
A neighbor in the Delhi region allegedly killed a man following ongoing disputes over parking spaces and household pets.

clusters.headline: Trinamool Congress MP Abhishek Banerjee Reports Attack On Residence
aiSummaryBullets: Trinamool Congress MP Abhishek Banerjee reported an attack on his residence during his birthday celebration.
The MP claimed this incident marks the seventh attempt on his life within the last six months.

clusters.headline: India Secures Narrow Series Lead Against New Zealand In Second ODI
aiSummaryBullets: India defeated New Zealand by four runs in the second ODI match.
The result was determined by the Duckworth-Lewis-Stern method following a rain interruption.

clusters.headline: Jharkhand Faces Political Unrest Following Tribal Activist's Death
aiSummaryBullets: Tribal activist Nisha Bhagat passed away on November 6 following public claims of harassment.
Bhagat had previously alleged in a live broadcast that the state government and land brokers targeted her.

clusters.headline: Rahul Gandhi Criticizes E20 Fuel Implementation Policies In India
aiSummaryBullets: Rahul Gandhi alleged that E20 fuel samples in Karnataka have exceeded established limits.
The politician characterized the E20 fuel program as a form of cheating directed at the general public.
